english_text: Praise belongs to God in satisfaction with God's decision!

arabic_text: شَهِدْتُ أَنَّ اللهَ قَسَمَ مَعَايِشَ عِبَادِهِ بِالْعَدْلِ ، وَأَخَذَ عَلَى جَمِيْعِ خَلْقِهِ بِالْفَضْلِ.
transliteration: shahidtu anna allah qasama ma'aish ibadihi bil-'adl waakhatha ʿala jameeʿi khalqihi bilfadli
english_text: I bear witness that God has apportioned the livelihoods of His servants with justice and undertaken bounty for all His creatures.

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَلاَ تَفْتِنِّي بِمَا أَعْطَيْتَهُمْ وَلا تَفْتِنْهُمْ بِمَا مَنَعْتَنِي فَأحْسُدَ خَلْقَكَ، وَأَغْمِطَ حُكْمَكَ.
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi walā taf'tinnī bimā aʿṭaytahum wa lā tafitnihum bimā manaʿtanī fa-aḥsuda khalqaka wa aghmita ḥukmaka
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, tempt me not with what Thou hast given to Thy creatures and tempt them not with what Thou hast withheld from me, lest I envy Thy creatures and despise Thy decision!

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ، وَطَيِّبْ بِقَضَائِـكَ نَفْسِي وَوَسِّعْ بِمَـواقِعِ حُكْمِكَ صَدْرِي وَهَبْ لِي الثِّقَةَ لأُقِرَّ مَعَهَا
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa ṭayyib biqaḍāʾika nafsī wa wasّiʿ bi mawāqiʿi ḥukmika ṣadrī wa hab li al-thiqah li uqirra maʿaha
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, delight my soul through Thy decree, expand my breast through the instances of Thy decision, give to me a trust through which I may admit

arabic_text: بِأََنَّ قَضَاءَكَ لَمْ يَجْرِ إلاَّ بِالْخِيَرَةِ وَاجْعَلْ شُكْرِي لَكَ عَلَى مَا زَوَيْتَ عَنّي أَوْفَرَ مِنْ شُكْرِي إيَّاكَ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنِي
transliteration: bi-ann qadā-aka lam yajri illa bil-khiyārah waaj'al shukri laka 'ala ma zawayta 'anni ʾawfara min shukrī iyāka ʿalā mā khawwaltanī
english_text: that Thy decree runs only to the best, and let my gratitude to Thee for what Thou hast taken away from me be more abundant than my gratitude to Thee for what Thou hast conferred upon me!

arabic_text: وَاعْصِمْنِي مِن أنْ أظُنَّ بِذِي عَدْم خَسَاسَةً، أَوْ أَظُنَّ بِصَاحِبِ ثَرْوَة فَضْلاً، فَإنَّ الشَّرِيفَ مَنْ شَرَّفَتْهُ طَاعَتُكَ، وَالْعَزِيزَ مَنْ أَعَزَّتْهُ عِبَادَتُكَ.
transliteration: waʿṣimnī min an ’aẓunna bi dhī ʿadmin khasāsah 'aw 'athunna biṣāḥibi tharwah faḍlan fa'inna al-sharīfa man sharraftuhu ṭā‘atuka wa al-ʿazīza man aʿazzahtuhu ʿibādatuka
english_text: Preserve me from imagining any meanness in someone who is destitute or imagining any superiority in someone who possesses wealth, for the noble is he whom obedience to Thee has ennobled and the exalted is he whom worship of Thee has exalted!

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَمَتِّعْنَا بِثَرْوَة لاَ تَنْفَدُ، وَأَيِّدْنَا بِعِزٍّ لاَ يُفْقَدُ وَأَسْرِحْنَا فِيْ مُلْكِ الأَبَدِ
transliteration: faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa mattiʿnā bi-tharwah lā tanfadu, wa ayyidnā bi-ʿizzin lā yufqadu wa-asriḥnā fī mulkil-ʾabadi
english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household, give us to enjoy a wealth which does not run out, confirm us with an exaltation which will never be lost, and let us roam freely in the kingdom of everlastingness!
Surely Thou art the One, 'the Unique, the Eternal Refuge;

arabic_text: الَّذِي لَمْ تَلِدْ وَلَمْ تُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَكَ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ.
transliteration: alladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad walam yakun laka kufuwan ahad
english_text: Thou hast not begotten, nor hast Thou been begotten, and equal to Thee is not any one' (ref.112:1-4)!
